display_name: Recommendations From the 2023 International Evidence-based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
document_title: Recommendations From the 2023 International Evidence-based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
what_it_supports: PCOS-specific metabolic, hormonal and reproductive outcomes
limitations: Do not generalize to people without PCOS.
No specific formulation or dose can be recommended from this evidence.
Pregnancy outcomes require separate evidence and assessment.
